title: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows an unauthenticated user to inject unauthorized…
description: The U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program contains a critical SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute unauthorized SQL commands. This flaw enables attackers to gain root access and full control over the database. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.8, indicating a critical severity level. A fix was made available on or around October 19, 2026.
